step_a: Fill every empty midpoint between equal-colored endpoints at diagonal distance two using the exact canonical rule.
intermediate: The bridged grid, especially the input-dependent set of newly completed three-cell diagonals.
step_b: For each completed three-cell diagonal in that bridged grid, paint the other two corners of its 3x3 box with the same color when those cells are empty.
why_b_depends_on_a: The generated inputs contain endpoint pairs but no completed same-color diagonal triples. Skipping Step A leaves Step B with no trigger, so it cannot create the X corners that the qualified alternate produces.
